GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
